title: I-SIRCH: AI-POWERED CONCEPT ANNOTATION TOOL FOR EQUITABLE EXTRACTION AND ANALYSIS OF SAFETY INSIGHTS FROM MATERNITY INVESTIGATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model concept annotation performance (using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F-score) and conducting statistical tests (e.g., Wilcoxon signed-rank test) to check for systematic performance disparities across different maternal ethnic groups (Asian, Black, White British, Mixed Background, and Other White).
